purpose: Three bounded counterbalanced paired timing allocations on development only, testing shared loading changes independently of LR selection.
source: score_dense adds optional pinned model.pt SHA checking before scoring receipt publication; no native optimizer/checkpoint state changes.
manifest: Same32development questions and immutable seed17matched15 checkpoints from round3; exact inputs/masks/scoring semantics. No new final examples.
control: serial full source hashing and serial full model SHA read then native restore
candidate: four source-hash workers and overlapped full SHA read/native restore; both stages retain every byte check
statistics: For each arm, paired speed ratios control_attempt_seconds/candidate_attempt_seconds across3restarts.95%Student-t interval(df2). Overall per-restart ratio uses sums acrossbotharms; require its lower bound>1.05 and each arm lower bound>1.0 for a reliable shared-scoring gain claim. Also report direct nonoverlapping preparation verification+checkpoint_read_and_restore phase ratios, raw timings, memory and node identity. Do not sum concurrent nested timers. Three restarts are timing replication, not new quality seeds/recordings.
parity: All384fresh-scored development observations must equal their pinned round4controls exactly; checkpoint SHA/provenance/objective/input identity exact.
failure_injection: First allocation runs15pinned helper tests and a final real-CUDA restore with an intentionally wrong expected SHA. Nonzero return, explicit checksum-mismatch error and absence of scores/summary/read-success receipt are required.
limits: No automatic extra timings after seeing intervals. Preserve uncertainty and negative results. Shared scoring gain is not optimizer end-to-end or inference latency.
